name: Advance Script Manager
description: Lets administrators add and manage custom JS/CSS/tracking snippets injected into the page header, body, or footer with per-path, role, and content-type visibility rules.
project_description: Advance Script Manager lets administrators register named JavaScript and CSS snippets and control where and when each one is injected, in a way similar to how the core Block module controls block placement. Each snippet is assigned to one of three regions (Header, Body, or Footer) and can be shown or hidden per Drupal path (allow/deny list), with optional role and content-type settings stored alongside it. Snippets are held in a dedicated database table, ordered by a draggable weight, and are disabled by default so code is not made live by accident. Header snippets are emitted via hook_page_attachments_alter(), body snippets via hook_page_top(), and footer snippets via hook_page_bottom(). It is a general replacement for per-site tracking/tag-injection modules and requires no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
